# Value to Victory

> Value to Victory helps people see where their time and value are leaking, using the P.I.N.K. framework (People, Influence, Numbers, Knowledge, Time). The starting point is a free, 5-minute, 25-question assessment that returns a P.I.N.K. Master Score and a pillar breakdown. Founded by Shawn E. Decker, author of *Running From Miracles* and *The Lost Art of Value*, who also offers membership and coaching.

## Start here

- [Free P.I.N.K. assessment](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/join): 25 questions, about 5 minutes, free score and report.
- [The Value Engine](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/): Assessment home, with full details in its own llms.txt at https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/llms.txt
- [About the P.I.N.K. framework](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/about-pink)
- [FAQ](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/faq)

## Membership, coaching and books

- [Pricing](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/pricing): VictoryPath $29/mo or $290/yr, Value Builder $47/mo or $470/yr, Victory VIP $497/mo.
- [Coaching](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/coaching) and [book a call](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/consult)
- [Running From Miracles — free book](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/free-book)

## AI skills, video design and coaching

- [AI Skills](https://valuetovictory.com/#ai-skills): Practical AI for small business owners, included in every membership. Level 1 (every plan): 100 prompts, which AI to use for what, 12 simple workflows, safety basics. Level 2 (Value Builder, Victory VIP): all 10 Top-10 AI Skill Packs with playbooks for 10 professions. Level 3 (Victory VIP): your own AI assistants, multi-step workflows, automations and agents with a human trust check.
- [AI Skill Packs](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/professionals): Playbooks applying AI to 10 professions.
- [Video design help](https://valuetovictory.com/#video-design): Short-form reels, brand and promo videos, captions and editing, and video ads for small business social media. Start with a free 30-minute call.
- [Coaching](https://valuetovictory.com/#services): Life, business and relationship coaching with Shawn Decker. [Book a free 30-minute call](https://assessment.valuetovictory.com/consult).
